map.vCard 二维码。vCard 二维码生成器。输入姓名、电话、邮箱、公司等名片信: vCard QR Code. vCard QR code generator. Enter business-card info such as name, phone, email, company, etc.; generate a scannable vCard QR code in the front end for easy electronic-card exchange; data is generated locally and not uploaded.
map.使用vCard QR Code时先明确输出用途和安全要求，再调整长度、字符集或字: Before using a vCard QR Code, clarify the output purpose and security requirements, then adjust length, character set, or fields; avoid directly adopting defaults that don't fit the business rules.
map.生成结果后先在本地预览和复制，确认没有多余空格、换行或遗漏字段，再粘贴到目标系统: After generating, preview and copy locally first; confirm no extra spaces, line breaks, or missing fields before pasting into the target system.
map.密码或个人信息只保存在自己的设备和密码管理器中，不要把结果发到聊天、日志或公共文: Keep passwords or personal info only on your own device and password manager; don't send results to chats, logs, or public documents.
map.示例：生成联系人二维码: Example: generate a contact QR code
map.填写姓名、电话与邮箱后生成 vCard 二维码，扫码即可添加到通讯录；信息仅在本: After entering name, phone, and email, generate a vCard QR code; scan to add to contacts; info is generated locally, not uploaded.
map.生成结果会上传到服务器吗？: Is the generated result uploaded to a server?
map.不会，生成过程在浏览器本地完成；不要把敏感结果复制到不受信任的第三方页面。: No, generation completes locally in the browser; don't copy sensitive results into untrusted third-party pages.
map.默认参数适合直接用于正式业务吗？: Are the default parameters suitable for formal business use directly?
map.不一定。正式使用前应按目标系统的长度、字符集和合规要求重新设置参数并自行复核。: Not necessarily. Before formal use, reconfigure parameters per the target system's length, character set, and compliance requirements and verify yourself.
